dct_title_s: Landslide impact analysis eThekwini, Metropolitan Municipality, KwaZulu-Natal Province, South Africa as of 21 April 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20220418ZAF** This map illustrates satellite-detected landslides/mudflow-related impact in eThekwini, Metropolitan Municipality, eThekwini District, KwaZulu-Natal Province, South Africa as observed from a Kompsat-3 image acquired on 21 April 2022. Within the analyzed area, 21 ha of landslide scars were observed. Based on Worldpop population data, about 55,000 people live inside the analyzed area. Within the analysis extent, UNITAR-UNOSAT identified 121 damaged structures and 247 potentially damaged structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
